choice_data_list:
You actually managed to beat Biwa 
Hayahide!

You actually managed to beat Biwa 
Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I see... So I won. Against Big Sis...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Brian. There's a limit to how 
utterly unconventional someone can be.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined someone could run like 
that in the Takarazuka Kinen as a 
Classic-class.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...To unleash such raw, unpolished talent 
to the fullest, all while still harboring 
so much room to grow."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about how you'll be once summer 
is over is terrifying. It feels like your 
back will be forever out of reach ahead of 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Still, this isn't the end, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"At the very least, I want to run once 
more. If races can be this thrilling...!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is the Twinkle Series. A place where 
everyone struggles and strives for the 
top.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Let's run again, Brian. Next time, it'll 
be my back you're looking at."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, definitely. I'll dodge right past 
you next time too...!"
